svg.text: SUBSTRATE EVOLUTION: v0.6.0 GROUND TRUTH vs. v0.6.1 SUBSTRATE GENERALITY
Comparative architectural analysis bridging foundational single-agent loop to recursive mediated delegation

g.text: v0.6.0 CONCEPT LOCK (FOUNDATION LAW)
1. Fixed Harness Manifest (harness.yaml)
• Dedicated pack structure (packs/code-default/)
• Flat plugins: [fs, ast-patch, repo-map, terminal, evaluation-gate]
• Inflexible guardrails: Sandbox & Evaluator mandatory across all runs
2. EpisodeEngine (Linear Turn Loop)
• Sequential dispatch: TurnStarted → Effect → TurnComplete
• Single logical agent driving tool executions sequentially
• spawn() capability is defined as runtime-managed subprocess
• Direct single-track budget debiting
Stop Condition (Wave 4): 1 real verified coding run against oracle
3. Rigid Exterior Verification
• Exterior daemon (UID 10002) mandatory for all runs
• All runs must produce signed verdict or fail
• Evaluator exteriority strictly preserved (ADR-0072)
Foundation Scope (Waves 0 – 4):
• Wave 0: CI Truth & Named Falsifiers
• Wave 1: Fail-Closed Trust Spine (F-01..F-15)
• Wave 2: One Runtime & Parity (F-16 green, layer0 absorption)
• Wave 3: Extensibility Walking Skeleton (Registry FSM, Echo Plugin)
• Wave 4: First Real Coding Run (STOP CONDITION)
Constraint: Zero kernel LOC expansion beyond 1438 budget.
No premature multi-agent or concurrency in foundation waves.
v0.6.1 SUBSTRATE GENERALITY (POST-FOUNDATION)
1. Component Graph Manifest Architecture
• Declarative DAG of components, ports, and selectors
• Multi-pack portability: Math Pack, Data Pack, Security Pack
• Canonical D_H covers arbitrary component compositions
2. Absent vs. Forged Guardrail Flexibility
• Declarable: evaluation = none / sandbox = none (safe offline tests)
• Unforgeable rule: Present but unsigned = Unconditional Deny
Absent = Flagged non-attributable; Forged = Fail-closed
3. Capability-Mediated agent.spawn (M-6)
• agent.spawn dispatched as a standard kernel verb
• Child agent gets strictly attenuated capability grant
• Parent leases sub-budget; child returns cryptographic receipt
Tree Search (MCTS), Debate, & Hierarchical Swarms as policy
Emergence Roadmap (M-5 through M-10):
• M-5: Post-Foundation Consolidation & Pack #2 Generality Proof
• M-6: Mediated Delegation (agent.spawn implementation)
• M-7: Controlled Concurrency (K << N worker isolation)
• M-8: Framework Builder Abstraction & Dynamic Swarms
• M-9: High Performance & Scaled Orchestration
• M-10: Meta-Cognitive Self-Improvement Singularity
Evolution occurs strictly on top of the verified foundation.
